title: Re-export pattern for UserCredential eliminates type-conversion shim
description: AuthConfig::users is Vec<UserCredential> and CredentialStore::from_credentials takes &[UserCredential]. Before this commit they were two different types — reader-local vs stoa_auth — requiring a mapping loop at the call site. The re-export (pub use stoa_auth::UserCredential) makes them the same type so from_credentials can receive auth.users directly with no shim. Alternative was keeping both types as distinct structs and maintaining a field-by-field mapping, which risks the two types drifting silently. Re-exporting is correct: the reader config is already a thin wrapper over stoa_auth types; making the type identity explicit removes a class of future divergence bugs.
